edges.reason: Modifier reads msg.sender to compute the caller's token balance.
propose uses msg.sender as proposer and balanceOf lookup.
vote uses msg.sender for receipt and vote weight.
withdraw uses msg.sender for lock check, transfer and burn.
lockVotes sets voteLock[msg.sender] = block.timestamp + votingPeriod.
state() logic depends entirely on block.timestamp comparisons, making proposal state timestamp-dependent.
propose records startTime = block.timestamp in the new proposal.
withdraw authorization relies on block.timestamp > voteLock[msg.sender], a timestamp-dependent access check.
state compares block.timestamp against startTime + votingPeriod.
lockVotes sets the lock duration from votingPeriod.
state compares block.timestamp against startTime + executionPeriod.
state marks a proposal Defeated when forVotes < quorumVotes.
propose requires balanceOf[msg.sender] >= proposalThreshold.
lockVotes calls votingToken.balanceOf and transferFrom on the stored token.
withdraw calls votingToken.transfer to return locked tokens.
propose increments proposalCount and uses it as the new proposal id.
state reads proposals[proposalId] to determine the proposal state.
execute reads proposals[_proposalId] for txHash check and executed flag.
propose writes the new proposal into proposals mapping.
vote reads and updates forVotes/againstVotes in proposals[_proposalId].
vote reads and writes receipts[_proposalId][msg.sender].
withdraw checks voteLock[msg.sender] for lock expiry.
lockVotes writes voteLock[msg.sender].
propose reads balanceOf[msg.sender] for the threshold check.
vote reads balanceOf[msg.sender] to compute vote weight.
withdraw transfers and burns balanceOf[msg.sender].
execute calls state(_proposalId) to require ReadyForExecution.
vote calls state(_proposalId) to require Active.
propose body is wrapped by the lockVotes modifier.
vote body is wrapped by the lockVotes modifier.
lockVotes calls _mint(msg.sender, tokenBalance) after pulling tokens.
withdraw calls _burn(msg.sender, balanceOf[msg.sender]) after transferring.
_mint increases balanceOf[_account].
_burn decreases balanceOf[_account].
The user-supplied _target is the delegatecall target.
The user-supplied _data is the delegatecall calldata.
execute performs a delegatecall to an arbitrary target, allowing arbitrary external code execution inside the contract context.
lockVotes performs the external transferFrom call.
transferFrom executes before balanceOf is minted and voteLock is set, so a malicious token can reenter propose().
transferFrom executes before internal state update, allowing reentrant vote() calls during the token callback.
withdraw performs the external transfer call.
withdraw transfers tokens before burning the internal balance, enabling reentrancy against withdraw().
_mint performs balanceOf[_account] += _amount.
_burn performs balanceOf[_account] -= _amount.
vote accumulates proposal.forVotes/againstVotes with the voter weight.
Constructor receives the _votingToken argument.
Constructor stores _votingToken into the votingToken state variable.
state() uses proposalId to index proposals.
execute() uses _proposalId to load the proposal.
execute() uses _target to build txHash and delegatecall.
execute() uses _data to build txHash and delegatecall.
propose() uses _target to build the proposal txHash.
propose() uses _data to build the proposal txHash.
vote() uses _proposalId to load state and proposal.
vote() uses _support to decide which tally to increment.
_mint credits _account.
_mint adds _amount.
_burn debits _account.
_burn subtracts _amount.
tokenBalance holds the pulled amount used for transfer, mint and lock.
txHash_execute is compared against proposal.txHash in execute.
success_execute gates the require after the delegatecall.
returnData_execute is returned to the execute caller.
proposal_execute points to the storage proposal being validated and marked executed.
txHash_propose is stored into the new proposal.
newProposal is the struct written into the proposals mapping.
proposal_vote is mutated with the voter weight.
receipt_vote records hasVoted, support and votes.
votes_vote is the weight added to a tally.
proposal_state is read to compute the ProposalState.
